code_summary: Pengiriman email ada di NotificationSmsEmailJob untuk perusahaan (idType B), tetapi untuk reminder ENA/RD*/DN*; tidak ada email berisi detail court summons.
note: Story: kirim email reminder berisi detail court summons ke perusahaan unik. Status kosong, tanpa demo_remark. Dicoba sinonim: state court, adjudicat, court mention, mention_date, hearing, court_case, courtreminder; di semua enam repo. DOS = DataHive/LTA cannot be confirmed from the repo. Pengiriman email ada untuk penerima idType B (ocmsadminprivateapi/src/main/java/com/ocmsintranet/cronservice/framework/workflows/notification_sms_email/jobs/NotificationSmsEmailJob.java:354, :378) tetapi untuk reminder ENA/RD*/DN*; stage DN1, DN2, DR3 melewati channel EMAIL (tidak ada template, ocmsadminprivateapi/src/main/java/com/ocmsintranet/cronservice/framework/workflows/notification_sms_email/helpers/NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:312-315). Mekanisme eNotification yang ada (ocmsadminprivateapi/src/main/java/com/ocmsintranet/cronservice/framework/workflows/notification_sms_email/helpers/NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java) memilih notice stage ENA/RD1/RD2/RR3/DN1/DN2/DR3 dengan parameter ENOTEDAYS per stage (ocmsadminprivateapi/src/main/java/com/ocmsintranet/cronservice/framework/workflows/notification_sms_email/helpers/NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:1108-1114), bukan notice court berdasarkan court mention date; ia dimatikan di prod (cron.notification.enabled=false, ocmsadminprivateapi/src/main/resources/cron-schedules-prod.properties:236); nilai server asli cannot verify from repo. email.enableSmtp=false di application-prod.properties:80 (nilai server asli cannot verify from repo).
recommendation: Evidence 33%. Jangan klaim fitur State Courts/court reminder; yang ada hanya mekanisme eNotification umum.
